task_summary: I am an integration tester. I need to design integration tests for the user registration functionality. Before defining the tests, I need to understand the main components involved in registration, their responsibilities, and how they interact when a new user creates an account. I also need to identify the main integration points that should be exercised during the tests. | design integration tests | user registration functionality | The diagram must make clear the main components involved in registration, their responsibilities, how they interact when a new user creates an account, and the main integration points that should be exercised during the tests.

selected_view.purpose: Component-and-Connector Runtime View for am integration tester integration tests user: runtime components and connectors. Relations: connectors and communication. Do not: source packages drawn as runtime nodes.
selected_view.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can effectively depict runtime components, connectors, and communication paths required to answer the connectivity and control-flow questions for integration testing.

component that handles user registration functionality
persistence or external connector used by user registration functionality

architectural_questions.text: What are the main components that implement the user registration functionality?
What are the specific responsibilities of each module involved in the user registration functionality?
What is the exact sequence of calls between parts when a new user creates an account in the user registration functionality?
Which connectors and communication paths link the components that handle the user registration functionality?
